versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed
* hide warning when no mihon extension is installed by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/845
* fix Restoring Backup deletes all manga library entries #848 
* some optimizations
* remove orphaned obsolete extensions from list by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/847
* correct package names for rpm based distros by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/844
* Add AVIF support to Linux by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/849
* Re add isNsfw by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/850
* hide warning when no mihon extension is installed pt.2 by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/851
* Better performance in code editor by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/852
* fix: show a real error state when startup fails by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/853
* feat: real error states, loading skeletons, and TV-ready recommendations and watch order by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/859
* fix: make the TV layout testable and stop the scaled UI clipping on desktop by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/860
* use different JVM for iOS by @Schnitzel5 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/861
* feat(ios): adopt the UIScene lifecycle by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/862
* Add Edit Metadata button to local extensions by @NBA2K1 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/863
* feat(ios): dark and tinted app icon variants by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/865
* fix: watch order timeline and global search results by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/864
* fix: guard the native assets hook before reading code config by @mrandhawa14 in https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/pull/866


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.8.4...v0.8.5
